data.description: Board request (chat DM @human:forrest, msg 118, 2026-08-30 17:49), verbatim: "also, we should be able to pin employees in the DM list section, then otherwise sort them by team prefix." Interpretation left to the planner, with hints: pinning is a per-viewer preference (localStorage is the established per-viewer store — identity already lives there); "team prefix" most cheaply reads as the actor-id role prefix (developer-, qa-, pm-, ceo-, cto-), though personnel frontmatter also carries a team: field via apps/chat/lib/personnel.js (AS-8) — planner picks one and says why. Touches the AS-8 roster/DM sidebar rendering.
data.title: Chat: pin employees in the DM sidebar; sort unpinned DMs by team prefix

data.body: Bumped low->medium per board DM msg 160 ('all the chat UX improvements'). Runs last in the UX queue: it restyles the same DM sidebar AS-23 collapses into a drawer on mobile — landing it after AS-23 avoids doing the sidebar work twice.

Plan written (cto-owen). Decisions: (1) pin state in localStorage keyed per identity — chat.pins.<me>, JSON array, try/catch degradation, no backend/export impact (UI preference, house chat.me precedent); (2) 'team prefix' = actor-id role prefix (agent:developer-marcus -> developer) not frontmatter team: — matches the verbatim naming convention, total over both sidebar lists incl. non-roster DMs and roster-degradation fallback, no parser-contract coupling; groups lexicographic, name tie-break; (3) pinned roster rows float to top sorted by the same comparator (deterministic, no drag-order); pins scoped to roster rows only, #dm-list gets the comparator but no pin affordance; (4) always-visible touch-first star toggle per row (post-AS-23), stopPropagation so it never opens the DM, aria-pressed; (5) ordering is a pure function of state so push badge bumps and the 60s reconcile can never shuffle rows. New pure module public/dm-sort.js + test/dm-sort.test.js per house extraction pattern; server/API/URL-state untouched; existing suites byte-identical.

Implementation complete (developer-marcus), commits deee325 + d5204df on feat/AS-18-dm-pinning. New pure module public/dm-sort.js (teamPrefix/rosterOrder/dmOrder/togglePin/sanitizePins) + test/dm-sort.test.js (10 tests); app.js wires state.pins (Set, localStorage chat.pins.<me>, per-identity reload on picker change), always-visible star toggle on non-self roster rows (aria-pressed/aria-label, stopPropagation, pure re-render no fetch); both #roster-list (pinned tier first) and #dm-list use the (teamPrefix, name) comparator. style.css: toggle chrome, pinned left-accent box-shadow, >=32px hit target in the <=700px block. ONE deviation from the plan's guards line: server.js gained exactly one STATIC_FILES entry for /dm-sort.js — the plan said 'server untouched' but the whitelist would 404 the new module and break the whole app; per the AS-17 house rule the entry + a served-over-HTTP test in api.test.js are mandatory (orchestrator confirmed this in the task directive). No API/route/lib changes, index.html untouched, all other existing test files byte-identical to master. Suite: 161 pass (was 150) on host and in the mountless Docker test container. node --check clean on all changed JS.

QA review (qa-priya), cold, branch feat/AS-18-dm-pinning @ b0ee0c7 vs master. VERDICT: PASS — recommend done + merge.

Suite: ran myself in the mountless Docker test container (docker compose --profile tools run --rm --build test): 161 pass / 0 fail — matches the implementer's claim. Guards: all 12 pre-existing test files byte-identical to master (verified per-file with git diff --quiet); api.test.js is a 12-line append-only addition (the AS-18 served-over-HTTP test, mirroring the AS-25 live.js pattern). index.html untouched, lib/* untouched, no URL-state or export changes.

Criteria: 1) PASS — pin toggle only in the non-self else-branch of rosterRow(); always visible (opacity .4 base, no hover-gating); click handler stopPropagation() severs the openRosterDm chain, and the AS-23 drawer closes only via selectConversation/scrim, so a pin tap cannot close it. 2) PASS — rosterOrder pins-first, both tiers (teamPrefix, name); dmOrder same comparator, no pin tier; unit-tested incl. pin-order-independence. 3) PASS — chat.pins.<me> loaded in loadIdentities() AND the picker change handler; loadPins/savePins fully try/catch-wrapped; hostile-value probes against sanitizePins (proto-pollution JSON, throwing toString, 100k-dupe array, non-arrays) all degrade to clean pins, no throw. 4) PASS — ordering is a pure function of (roster, conversations, pins); probe confirmed output invariant to input array order; push badge bumps and reconcile funnel through the same full re-sort. 5) PASS — aria-pressed + aria-label('Pin/Unpin <name>'); <=700px block gives the toggle min 32x32 + 6px padding. 6) PASS per suite/guards above. 7) PASS WITH JUDGED DEVIATION — server.js +1 STATIC_FILES entry for /dm-sort.js. Judgment: deviation is correct and mandatory. The plan's 'server untouched' guard was internally inconsistent with its own design (a new public ES module needs a whitelist entry or the whole module graph 404s — precedent: prior review blocked a branch for exactly this with scroll.js). The +12-line api.test.js append is the same house rule's required proof and travels with it. No route, API, or behavior change beyond serving the new file.

Attack findings (none blocking): pinning an id that leaves the roster is ignored by rosterOrder (unit-tested) and the stale pin self-heals nothing but hurts nothing; XSS-shaped names/ids flow through sort untouched and rendering is el()/textContent + setAttribute only; localStorage disabled entirely degrades to no-pins via the try/catch wrappers. One observation, below trivia: togglePin(pins, undefined) would store a null that sanitizePins scrubs on next load — reachable only if a roster row ever lacked actorId; self-healing, no action needed.

Inline fixes: none (nothing trivial to fix; no commits by me).
